> 第五章 进城（第1页）
清月和阿火把酒都抬上了马车，一切都准备就绪。叶哥站在小馆的门口看着他们，道：“一路顺风，等你们回来！”
三辆马车，最前是载人的，后两辆马车是装货物的，有俩马夫，共五人同行。柳卿跟叶哥打了声招呼后就往第一马车去，清月很是有礼地扶着她上了马车，她与清月在马车里头，阿火便在外头赶车。
进城的路途稍微有点远，一路上她看着车窗外的风景，有时候会探出一点头儿。高大的树木，碧绿的叶子，路边还长着有艳有淡......
海神殿玩家正要重振旗鼓，没有察觉到海底下，一团阴影悄然而至。
眼眸微微闪烁了一下，云昂平静的转过了身体，看向了说话之人。
身为世俗的权势顶端的武侯，又是生平领兵无数的沙场大将军，这北镇武侯的威严极为深重，别的不说，北镇武侯府的下人对于这位主子可是十分敬畏的，此刻一动一惊之间，自然有着很大的气场。
“这套衣服挺有意思的！”一个修行者看出了李仪倩没有使用灵力。
欧阳止嘴上连连道谢，心里却想，定然没什么特赦，且不说木长龙和米永清二人死了，单单你李君度敢到这里来就说明一切，若有特赦，你英王定要杀灭我们这些知道你与大明遗孤合作的人。
发动噬虫的虫海战术对付元婴期高手是已经成功的手段，不过消耗的能量点至少在10亿以上。
剧情大概如此，目标自然也出来了，就是帮原主分析一下她到底是不是爸爸最爱的孩子。
“喝光了？那也总归能留下点什么，你去厨房看看，凡是可疑的都找出来……”东离恨坐在床边，指使黑衣人下去查探。
看着苏月吃下那绝情蛊，云逸轩这才上前拿起东西给齐淼解毒，他先给齐淼喂下碗里的汤药，齐淼本在昏睡，喝了那汤药后，面色忽然变得难看起来。
龙华虽然没有开口，但却教给了我剑道之法。我林奕可以不用，但却不能无视。
所以老雷同意了一定配合李德伟市长，将伤害李修礼的元凶找出来。
到了，前方虚无之中出现的修士大军，便是赤天宗弟子。虽然还看不清楚，但赵光明却在其中看到了赤阳道人的身影。
不过，这家伙倒是很看的开，能够进入十六强，已经是很不错的成绩了，至少招几个下流胚子的时候，还是能够做做广告的。
但是赵铸也怕，怕她在受伤时手拿不稳，忽然一抖，哪怕是匕首刺破了自己一点皮肤，也是不好的，因为这匕首来自于那个潜入毡房的刺客，上面有毒，赵铸此时的情况已经很糟糕了，如果再中毒，那就是屋漏偏逢连夜雨。
县令起初还老大不满意，后拗不过大官人，大官人在当地是地头蛇，黑白两路都得给些薄面。

他来不及了，一切都晚了，在他心软的留下林孝瑜，又痴痴不忘林孝珏的时候就什么都完了。
算了，为了隐藏职业资格，走一趟吧，斩首任务而已，大不了掉一级。
道理是如此，但是丽姨娘已经住在那十多年，现在让她搬走不是找着吵架吗？
“将来有一天，我会将我的名字刻印在上面。”狼宏翔的语气很是平淡，却是带着无法反驳的自信。
卢母听见孙有财语气不悦，心一惊，暗骂道，就死丫头还不见回来，要害死老母了。
对于一般的修行者而言，那到底是什么样的神人才能做到的事情？？
尧慕尘谨慎的在城里转了几圈，直至确定无人跟踪后，才化成一道白芒回了城边的居住地。

> Chapter 5 Entering the City (Page 1)
Qingyue and Ah Huo loaded the wine into the carriage and everything was ready. Brother Ye stood at the door of the tavern, looked at them, and said, "Have a nice trip, I'll wait for you to come back!"
There are three carriages, the first carriage is for people, the last two carriages are for cargo, and there are two grooms, a total of five people traveling together. Liu Qing said hello to Brother Ye and then went to the first carriage. Qingyue helped her get into the carriage politely. She and Qingyue were in the carriage, while Ah Huo drove outside.
The journey into the city was a bit far, and along the way she looked at the scenery outside the car window, sometimes sticking her head out. Tall trees, green leaves, bright and light flowers growing on the roadside...
The Poseidon players were about to regroup, but they didn't notice a shadow coming quietly under the sea.
His eyes flickered slightly, and Yun Ang calmly turned around and looked at the speaker.
As the most powerful person in the world, Marquis Wu, and a general who has led numerous armies on the battlefield, the Marquis Wu of Beizhen is extremely majestic. Not to mention anything else, the servants of Marquis Wu of Beizhen are in awe of their master. They naturally have a great aura when they move or startle at this moment.
"This outfit is quite interesting!" A practitioner saw that Li Yiqian did not use spiritual power.
Ouyang Zhi thanked him profusely, but thought in his heart that there must be no amnesty. Not to mention that Mu Changlong and Mi Yongqing were dead, just the fact that you, Li Jundu, dared to come here shows everything. If there is an amnesty, you, the King of England, will definitely kill those of us who know that you cooperated with the orphans of the Ming Dynasty.
Launching the insect-eating sea of ​​​​insects tactic to deal with Nascent Soul masters is a successful method, but it consumes at least 1 billion energy points.
The plot is roughly like this, and the goal is naturally revealed, which is to help the original owner analyze whether she is her father's favorite child.
"Drink it all? There is always something left. Go to the kitchen and find out anything suspicious..." Dong Lihen sat beside the bed and ordered the man in black to go down and investigate.
Watching Su Yue eat the Heartless Gu, Yun Yixuan stepped forward and picked up something to detoxify Qi Miao. He first fed Qi Miao the soup in the bowl. Qi Miao was already sleeping, but after drinking the soup, her complexion suddenly became ugly.
Although Long Hua didn't speak, he taught me the art of swordsmanship. I, Lin Yi, can use it, but I can’t ignore it.
So Lao Lei agreed to cooperate with Mayor Li Dewei to find the culprit who hurt Li Xiuli.
When we arrived, the army of monks that appeared in the void ahead were the disciples of the Red Sky Sect. Although he couldn't see clearly yet, Zhao Guangming saw the figure of Taoist Chiyang in it.
However, this guy is very open-minded. Being able to enter the top sixteen is already a very good achievement. At least he can still advertise when he recruits a few dirty guys.
But Zhao Zhu was also afraid, fearing that her hand would not be steady when she was injured. If she suddenly shook, even if the dagger pierced a little of her skin, it would be bad, because the dagger came from the assassin who sneaked into the yurt, and it was poisonous. Zhao Zhu's situation was already very bad at this time. If he was poisoned again, it would be a leak in the house and it rained all night.
The county magistrate was dissatisfied at first, but later he couldn't win over the high-ranking officials. The high-ranking officials were local gangsters, and both the black and white had to give him some thin noodles.
He was too late, everything was too late. When he left Lin Xiaoyu soft-heartedly and never forgot Lin Xiaojue, everything was over.
Forget it, in order to hide the professional qualifications, let's go there. It's just a beheading mission. The worst is to lose a level.
This is true, but Aunt Li has lived there for more than ten years. If she is asked to move out now, wouldn't she be looking for a quarrel?
"One day in the future, I will engrave my name on it." Lang Hongxiang's tone was very calm, but it was filled with irrefutable confidence.Mother Lu was startled when she heard Sun Youcai's displeased tone, and cursed secretly that she was going to kill her mother if she didn't come back yet.
For ordinary practitioners, what kind of thing can a god do? ?
Yao Muchen cautiously walked around the city a few times until he was sure that no one was following him, then he turned into a white light and returned to his residence on the edge of the city.
